title: Light Weight
text: Light Weight. This is a cute, light weight, rustic wall piece. It has a fairly authentic chicken wire look to it. When my husband got his tools out to hang this, he wasn't sure what how to do it. It comes with the wall screws, but my unit was missing any hanging pieces attached to the shelf. I went and looked up the product description and the pictures showed two hangers and so did some of the other reviews. It seems like this one is not the norm.  So as of now, my husband hasn't decided how he's going to hang these. Overall, it's a nice unit. There's plenty of room in the basket portion. The towel rack is large enough for a bath towel. But with the missing hanging pieces, it's not an easy thing to install.

features: The basket itself measures 8.25 x 5.5 x 4", and the whole construction with the towel bar is 8.25 x 5.5 x 10".

description: Crafted of antiqued finish “chicken coop” metal wire for a vintage look, and a sturdy frame, this wall mount shelf will be a great addition to your interior.
